description: Preview what the code generator would write for this project's current metadata (target/classes/exeris-metadata), without writing anything into the project. It runs the project's own generator in a separate process — for 'ts' the @exeris/codegen-ts installed in the project's node_modules, confined by Node's permission model to write only its scratch directory; for 'java' the eu.exeris:exeris-codegen-cli jar from the local Maven repository at the version the project pins — never downloaded and never substituted; when none resolves, a structured generator_unavailable with a reason and remedy. Returns the files it produced as added, changed, unchanged and removed against the committed generated tree (src/main/generated/java for Java, the codegen outputPath for TypeScript), a unified diff for each added or changed file, and the run's diagnostics with every EXT- identifier decoded as build-explain_diagnostic does. 'unchanged' includes hand-written files already in the committed tree, which the run starts from; the generator's own manifest file is not listed. Unlike the present:false answers of the other build-* tools, this one cannot answer without metadata, so a project that has not been built returns the error metadata_missing: run the project build first (mvn compile). Metadata whose names could not be a Java identifier or a package are refused as metadata_invalid before any generator starts. Bounded by a timeout and by output and file-size caps; a run over one is stopped and the limit is named. Local only; the output exists in a temporary directory removed when the call returns.
name: build-preview_generation
